Name: Ultimate Villager Manager
Author: ApollyonSV
Description:
[center][size=6][b][u]Please Read First[/u][/b][/size]


[size=3]As of right now, I will NOT be working on this project much. Thank you to everybody who has helped me with this project and those who have downloaded it. The reason I will not be working on this anymore is due to just too busy of a work schedule[/size][size=3]. I have decided to remove the version compatible with SVE as I don't see myself updating it ever. Again, thank you all so much for the support over the years.﻿[/size][size=4][b]

This mod will NOT make changes to any dialogue or villager changes made from any mod or make changes to any other language other than English.
[/b][/size]


[size=6][b][u]About This Mod[/u][/b][/size]

[size=3]This mod will allow you to change a villagers [/size][b]Name[/b][size=3], [/size][b]Possessive form[/b][size=3] (for accurate grammar), [/size][b]Gender, [/b][size=3]and now [/size][b]Birthdays[/b][size=3]! I first started making mods using [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4251]OkaMoez's Villager Name Replacer[/url][size=3] mod and idea (with permission of course) to create and improve my own Villager Name Replacer that would add in a lot more missing content and function that the old mod was lacking. I wanted to go one step further and allow the use of changing the gender as well. I went through all the game files and created dynamic tokens for every single villager and their pronoun to try and make it reflect as accurate as possible when a name or gender was changed. Please note that this mod does NOT make any visual changes. Check out the information of the beta version below to find out more on that.[/size]


[b][u][size=6]My goal[/size]

[/u][/b][size=3]My main goal when I made this mod was to create more user customization of the existing villagers. This mod has a higher priority load than most so it can be paired with other existing mods and will not overwrite what changes they make if that other mod adds something such as dialogue. I want to encourage modders, writers, and artists to create their own mods such as portrait/sprite mods, dialogue mods,  etc. and not have to be worried about being confined to something such as an existing villager's name or gender when paired with this mod. Dialogue can still be tweaked and added to make a new character even that more unique! If you plan on releasing your very own mod to change one or multiple villagers and wish to have this mod as an additional file already configured to download, you have my full permission, but please don't forget to leave credit to myself and this page. If you create a mod using this one to help and wish to have it linked on this page, reach out to me! I would be more than happy to have a section dedicated to your creations to show them off.[/size]



[size=3]A small note to mod authors who want to use my mod as a base for character changes - If you would like to create your own character mod to replace sprites and gender, please use the original character spritesheet locations to create custom villager. I've made some changes in SV v1.5 where villager relationship now shows up accurately on the social tab (boyfriend/girlfriend and husband/wife). Do not change the locations of the sprites for the wedding and flower dance on each original spritesheet or it will break the events. I've set it up so during the events, it calls on the original NPCDispositions and then changes once the event is over. Since changing the Disposition was the only way I found would edit relationship status accurately, I had to find a way to revert temporarily so that there was no mistakes. There are extra images in the files now that contain each villagers wedding sprites. If you plan on creating a custom villager, you need to adjust those separate wedding sprites as well. Would like to give a shoutout to [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/6056146?tab=user+files]NoFogBob[/url][size=3]﻿, someone who helped me create this fix and also someone I've been working on some future projects with. If you have any further questions, my discord is posted at the bottom of the description.[/size]


[u][b][size=6]Installation[/size]
[/b][/u]
[size=3]- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Pathoschild's Content Patcher[/url]﻿ if you don't have it already
- Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. I highly recommend this as it will make configuring the in game changes a whole lot easier
- Download Ultimate Villager Manager
- Unpack the contents of the archive to your .../StardewValley/Mods folder using a program such as WinRAR

*If you have the Generic Mod Config Menu downloaded, just click on the lower left cog button on the main menu screen, find Ultimate Villager Manager, and make changes there. Don't forget to save and close!

*If you do not have the Generic Mod Config Menu downloaded, using Penny as an example, find the config.json and your changes should look something like this (minus the spaces put in possessive, just wanted to make it easier to read):
"PennyName": "Penny"  -->  "PennyName": "Chris"
"PennyPossessive": " 's "  -->  "PennyPossessive": " ' "
"PennyGender": "Female"  -->  "PennyGender": "Male" 
"PennyBirthSeason": "fall"   -->   "PennyBirthSeason": "winter"
"PennyBirthDay": "2"   -->   "PennyBirthDay": "8"

Launch the game and enjoy![/size]

[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/15599024]ariasonata[/url][size=3] is creating a mod paired with this for a dialogue overhaul so can’t wait for that! Will link here once it’s published.
